concerns.text: Phase 9 (T401-T415) implements features explicitly defined as 'out-of-scope' in spec.md Assumptions and FR-011. T406 (Conformational Ensemble Sampling) and T407 (Hydration Control Experiment) violate the constraint to use 'single lowest-energy conformer' and 'gas-phase DFT calculations'. T401 (Peptide Planarity) and T409 (Physics-Informed Loss) introduce architectural constraints not present in the spec, effectively weakening the 'lightweight SchNet' requirement (FR-004) by adding unverified physics layers.

Task T018 generates 'Coulomb matrices' as 2D descriptors. However, plan.md (Statistical Power & Methodology) explicitly restricts the Random Forest baseline to 'strictly 2D features (Morgan Fingerprints, topological counts)' and excludes Coulomb matrices as '3D-derived'. This task silently relaxes the baseline definition, invalidating the comparative validity of the research question (3D vs 2D).

Tasks T049, T050, and T052 implement per-step decorators for time, CPU, and memory limits. However, FR-010 and SC-003 define the 6h runtime and 8GB memory as hard constraints for the *entire pipeline execution*. No task exists to enforce or measure the *aggregate* pipeline runtime against this limit (T094 only validates state file timestamps, not actual execution time). This is a semantic weakening of the global constraint.

Tasks T408 and T410 imply a shift toward 'experimental validation' or 'physical reality' benchmarks (responding to simulated expert critiques). This contradicts spec.md FR-011 and plan.md Constitution Check which explicitly forbid external experimental validation and define QM9 DFT data as the sole ground truth. The tasks attempt to validate against 'physical reality' rather than the specified DFT reference.

Task T210 is marked as completed ([X]) but the 'Analyze Report' section indicates it was rejected for failing to produce the research.md artifact. This state inconsistency (checked box vs. rejected status) violates the versioning discipline and creates a false sense of completion for a critical documentation task.
